Nord2Metal is NOT changed; accepted: thumbsync, vt23, thumbstage, thumbfix, gpuview, thumbfix2, thumbdiag, thumbcomp, thumbcomp2, thumbcomp3, thumbcomp4, thumbcomp5. Library accepted: base, thumbrc, camstats1, gnr1, libmerge1, libmerge2, libmerge3, libmerge4, libmerge5 (their backups/records stay), or libmerge6 (idempotent). Backup libredwoodair.dylib.pre-libmerge6, receipt record libmerge6; undo: guest-libmerge6-undo.sh with payload-libmerge6-undo.
